title: Exploring Algor's Terror-Dome

html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many Branches connected to Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring Algor's Terror-Dome

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many Branches connected to Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

I need someone to go and map out the branches inside Upper Algor's Terror-Dome. Are you up for it?

The King's Board of Trustees is very excited about Algor' Terror-Dome because of it's vast amount of natural resources. They need someone to get in there and explore it so the reaping can begin.

Return to me, Loremaster Vraile, in Townston when you have mapped out all the intersecting areas in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome.

Turn-in:

Back for more, eh. Good, because I have more for you.

Objectives:

  • Explore Subterrorania
  • Explore Arborgeddon
  • Explore Haterium

Client level range: 10–25
